picture.alt: A sunny day in an apartment complex: tall cream-and-orange apartment buildings and green trees behind, a blue sky with a few white clouds. Three young people walk side by side along a paved path, all smiling and talking. On the left, a young woman with shoulder-length wavy dark hair and round glasses wears a white short-sleeved shirt under a dark purple sweater vest and olive-green trousers, a beige cloth bag on her shoulder. In the middle, a young woman with long wavy black hair and gold hoop earrings wears a bright blue jacket over an orange top and cream-white wide trousers, a black bag on her shoulder. On the right, a young man with short black hair wears an open dark-blue shirt over a white T-shirt and rust-orange trousers; he looks at the two women and stretches one arm out to the side as if showing them the place. Right beside the path, in front of them, is a swimming pool; further back on the right are a tennis court with a net behind a green fence, a wooden shelter with a bench, bushes and pink flowers. Nobody is swimming, playing ball, sitting down or eating.

From left: a young woman with round glasses, wavy dark hair, a white shirt under a purple vest and green trousers, a mooncake in one hand and the other hand reaching toward the plate; a young man with black hair in a light-green jacket over a red striped T-shirt; a young woman with long wavy black hair in a blue jacket and white trousers; a young man with wavy brown hair in a yellow sweater vest over a purple shirt; and a young man with short black hair in a dark-blue shirt over a white T-shirt, his hand reaching for a mooncake on the plate. passage.traditional: 去年我們家搬到台北市郊區的一個社區。剛搬來的時候，我不太{1}，因為附近沒有捷運站，去哪裡都得先走十分鐘去搭公車。還好社區裡有一家二十四小時的超市，{2}買東西也會很麻煩。社區白天、晚上都有人{3}安全，空氣也很{4}。現在我越來越喜歡住在這裡了。
passage.simplified: 去年我们家搬到台北市郊区的一个社区。刚搬来的时候，我不太{1}，因为附近没有捷运站，去哪里都得先走十分钟去搭公车。还好社区里有一家二十四小时的超市，{2}买东西也会很麻烦。社区白天、晚上都有人{3}安全，空气也很{4}。现在我越来越喜欢住在这里了。
passage.pinyin: Qùnián wǒmen jiā bān dào Táiběi Shì jiāoqū de yí ge shèqū. Gāng bān lái de shíhòu, wǒ bú tài xíguàn, yīnwèi fùjìn méiyǒu jiéyùn zhàn, qù nǎlǐ dōu děi xiān zǒu shí fēnzhōng qù dā gōngchē. Háihǎo shèqū lǐ yǒu yì jiā èrshísì xiǎoshí de chāoshì, yàobùrán mǎi dōngxi yě huì hěn máfán. Shèqū báitiān, wǎnshàng dōu yǒu rén fùzé ānquán, kōngqì yě hěn xīnxiān. Xiànzài wǒ yuè lái yuè xǐhuān zhù zài zhèlǐ le.
passage.english: Last year my family moved to a housing complex in the suburbs of Taipei City. When we had just moved in, I wasn't really used to it, because there's no MRT station nearby: wherever we go, we first have to walk ten minutes to catch a bus. Luckily there's a 24-hour supermarket in the complex; otherwise shopping would be a nuisance too. Someone is in charge of security day and night, and the air is fresh. Now I like living here more and more.

questions.why: 我不太習慣: at first the writer was not used to the place, because there is no MRT station nearby.
還好……，要不然……: luckily there is a 24-hour supermarket; otherwise shopping would be a nuisance too.
有人負責安全: someone is in charge of the security of the complex day and night.
空氣很新鮮: the air in the suburbs is fresh.

passage.traditional: 上個星期六是{1}，社區在大門旁邊的草地上{2}了一個野餐活動。大家都帶了自己做的菜，{3}吃，一邊聊天。吃飽以後，有的人去踢足球，有的人在花園裡散步，也有的人躺在草地上曬太陽。我躺在草地上，看著天上的雲，感覺好{4}，真希望每個週末都能這樣。
passage.simplified: 上个星期六是{1}，社区在大门旁边的草地上{2}了一个野餐活动。大家都带了自己做的菜，{3}吃，一边聊天。吃饱以后，有的人去踢足球，有的人在花园里散步，也有的人躺在草地上晒太阳。我躺在草地上，看着天上的云，感觉好{4}，真希望每个周末都能这样。
passage.pinyin: Shàng ge xīngqíliù shì qíngtiān, shèqū zài dàmén pángbiān de cǎodì shàng bàn le yí ge yěcān huódòng. Dàjiā dōu dài le zìjǐ zuò de cài, yìbiān chī, yìbiān liáotiān. Chībǎo yǐhòu, yǒude rén qù tī zúqiú, yǒude rén zài huāyuán lǐ sànbù, yě yǒude rén tǎng zài cǎodì shàng shài tàiyáng. Wǒ tǎng zài cǎodì shàng, kànzhe tiān shàng de yún, gǎnjué hǎo qīngsōng, zhēn xīwàng měi ge zhōumò dōu néng zhèyàng.
passage.english: Last Saturday was a sunny day, and the complex held a picnic on the lawn beside the main gate. Everyone brought a dish they had made, and we ate and chatted at the same time. After we had eaten our fill, some people went to play soccer, some took a walk in the garden, and some lay on the grass in the sun. I lay on the lawn watching the clouds in the sky and felt so relaxed. I really wish every weekend could be like that.

questions.why: 上個星期六是晴天: it was a sunny day, good weather for a picnic and lying in the sun.
辦了一個野餐活動: the complex held (organised) a picnic.
The sentence already has a second 一邊 (一邊聊天), so the first half needs 一邊 too: 一邊吃，一邊聊天, two things at once.
感覺好輕鬆: lying on the grass watching the clouds, the writer feels very relaxed.

text.traditional: 我家住的社區在山上，社區裡有球場，也有游泳池。妹妹像爸爸一樣，很愛運動，下課以後有時候去打球，有時候去游泳。哥哥像媽媽一樣，喜歡安靜，常常在家看書、聽音樂。週末的時候，我們常常一起去社區的草地上野餐。
text.simplified: 我家住的社区在山上，社区里有球场，也有游泳池。妹妹像爸爸一样，很爱运动，下课以后有时候去打球，有时候去游泳。哥哥像妈妈一样，喜欢安静，常常在家看书、听音乐。周末的时候，我们常常一起去社区的草地上野餐。

Gēge xiàng māma yíyàng, xǐhuān ānjìng, chángcháng zài jiā kàn shū, tīng yīnyuè. Zhōumò de shíhòu, wǒmen chángcháng yìqǐ qù shèqū de cǎodì shàng yěcān.
text.english: The housing complex my family lives in is in the hills, and it has a ball court and a swimming pool. My younger sister is just like Dad: she loves sport, and after school she sometimes plays ball and sometimes goes swimming. My older brother is just like Mum: he likes peace and quiet, and often stays home reading or listening to music. At weekends we often go for a picnic together on the lawn in the complex.

text.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě shàng ge yuè bān dào jiāoqū de yí ge shèqū. Tā de xīn jiā xiàng yǐqián zhù de dìfāng yíyàng dà, yě yǒu liǎng jiān wòshì. Zhèlǐ bǐ yǐqián zhù de dìfāng ānjìng duō le, wǎnshàng tīng bú dào chēzi de shēngyīn, kěshì lí jiéyùn zhàn bǐjiào yuǎn, tā měi tiān dōu děi zǎo yìdiǎn chūmén, xiān dā shèqū de bāshì dào jiéyùn zhàn.
text.english: Last month Ms. Zhang moved to a housing complex in the suburbs. Her new home is just as big as the place she lived before, with two bedrooms as well. prompt.english: A man who lives in the complex brings two friends who live outside it to swim on Sunday. How much do they pay in all?

questions.why: 只要是住在社區的人，就……不用付錢: he lives in the complex, so he swims free; his two friends pay 一個人一次一百塊, so 200 in all. The pool is open on Sundays; only Mondays are closed.

text.traditional: 我的室友人很好，除了常常替我買早飯，還把房間打掃得很乾淨。可是我們的生活習慣很不一樣。他每天早上五點就起床，在房間裡聽音樂，聲音很大，我常常沒辦法睡覺。雖然我很喜歡他，可是我還是決定下個學期搬出去住。
text.simplified: 我的室友人很好，除了常常替我买早饭，还把房间打扫得很干净。可是我们的生活习惯很不一样。他每天早上五点就起床，在房间里听音乐，声音很大，我常常没办法睡觉。虽然我很喜欢他，可是我还是决定下个学期搬出去住。
text.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu rén hěn hǎo, chúle chángcháng tì wǒ mǎi zǎofàn, hái bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de hěn gānjìng. Kěshì wǒmen de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn bù yíyàng. Tā měi tiān zǎoshàng wǔ diǎn jiù qǐchuáng, zài fángjiān lǐ tīng yīnyuè, shēngyīn hěn dà, wǒ chángcháng méi bànfǎ shuìjiào. Suīrán wǒ hěn xǐhuān tā, kěshì wǒ háishì juédìng xià ge xuéqí bān chūqù zhù.
text.english: My roommate is a really nice person. Besides often buying breakfast for me, he also keeps our room very clean. But our habits are very different. He gets up at five every morning and plays music loudly in the room, so I often can't sleep. Although I like him a lot, I've still decided to move out next semester.

prompt.traditional: 他為什麼決定搬出去住？
prompt.simplified: 他为什么决定搬出去住？
prompt.pinyin: Tā wèishénme juédìng bān chūqù zhù?
prompt.english: Why has the writer decided to move out?

choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu bú tì tā mǎi zǎofàn le.
choices.english: The roommate doesn't buy him breakfast any more.
The roommate is too noisy in the mornings.

choices.pinyin: Shìyǒu bǎ fángjiān nòng de hěn zāng.
choices.english: The roommate makes the room very dirty.
The roommate is too noisy at night.

questions.why: 每天早上五點就起床，在房間裡聽音樂，聲音很大: the roommate plays loud music from five in the morning, so the writer can't sleep. It is mornings, not evenings; he keeps the room clean (把房間打掃得很乾淨) and buys breakfast (除了……，還……).

text.traditional: 我哥哥工作很忙，已經兩個星期沒打掃房間了。房東本來說今天要來看房子，後來又說下個月再來；同事本來也要來他家看球賽，後來大家決定去同事家看。昨天下午媽媽打電話說今天要來看他，他才趕快把房間打掃乾淨。媽媽來了以後說：「你的房間比上次乾淨多了！」
text.simplified: 我哥哥工作很忙，已经两个星期没打扫房间了。房东本来说今天要来看房子，后来又说下个月再来；同事本来也要来他家看球赛，后来大家决定去同事家看。昨天下午妈妈打电话说今天要来看他，他才赶快把房间打扫干净。妈妈来了以后说：「你的房间比上次干净多了！」
text.pinyin: Wǒ gēge gōngzuò hěn máng, yǐjīng liǎng ge xīngqí méi dǎsǎo fángjiān le. Fángdōng běnlái shuō jīntiān yào lái kàn fángzi, hòulái yòu shuō xià ge yuè zài lái; tóngshì běnlái yě yào lái tā jiā kàn qiúsài, hòulái dàjiā juédìng qù tóngshì jiā kàn. Zuótiān xiàwǔ māma dǎ diànhuà shuō jīntiān yào lái kàn tā, tā cái gǎnkuài bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo gānjìng. Māma lái le yǐhòu shuō: "Nǐ de fángjiān bǐ shàng cì gānjìng duō le!"
text.english: My older brother is very busy with work and hadn't cleaned his room for two weeks. His landlord had said he would come to look at the flat today, then said he would come next month instead; his colleagues were also going to come over to watch a game, but then everyone decided to watch it at a colleague's place. Yesterday afternoon Mum called to say she was coming to see him today, and only then did he hurry to clean his room. When Mum arrived she said, "Your room is much cleaner than last time!"

prompt.traditional: 哥哥為什麼昨天打掃房間？
prompt.simplified: 哥哥为什么昨天打扫房间？
prompt.pinyin: Gēge wèishénme zuótiān dǎsǎo fángjiān?
prompt.english: Why did the older brother clean his room yesterday?

choices.english: His landlord was coming that day.
His colleagues were coming to watch a game.
His mother was coming that day.
He thought his room was too dirty.

questions.why: 媽媽打電話說今天要來看他，他才趕快把房間打掃乾淨: his mother's visit is what made him clean. The landlord put his visit off to next month, and the colleagues watched the game at someone else's home.
